mkdir -p $TMPDIR/q && cat > $TMPDIR/q/parse.py <<'EOF'
import re, glob, os, sys
UTIL = ["centerpoint","northern indiana public service","nipsco","citizens gas","citizens energy","vectren","indiana american water","ohio valley gas","american electric power","duke energy","community natural gas","midwest natural gas","frontier communications"]
d = "/tmp/r2run-lqu4au25/data/text"
rows = []
blank = 0
for f in sorted(glob.glob(d+"/*.txt")):
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"^=== page (\d+)\s*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    # pages = [pre, num, body, num, body...]
    for i in range(1, len(pages), 2):
        pno, body = pages[i], pages[i+1]
        if not re.search(r"Case Number:\s*\S", body) and "RecommendationForm" not in body:
            continue
        m = re.search(r"Case Number:[ \t]*(\S+)", body)
        cn = m.group(1) if m else ""
        if not cn:
            blank += 1
            continue
        resp = re.search(r"Respondent:[ \t]*(.*)", body)
        resp = resp.group(1).strip() if resp else ""
        cite = re.search(r"finds the following violation\(s\):(.*?)The Advisory Committee recommends", body, re.S)
        cite = " ".join(cite.group(1).split()) if cite else ""
        rec = re.search(r"recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)Abstentions:", body, re.S)
        rec_t = " ".join(rec.group(1).split()) if rec else None
        addl = re.search(r"Additional Information:(.*?)APPROVED", body, re.S)
        addl_t = " ".join(addl.group(1).split()) if addl else ""
        rows.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f), page=pno, case=cn, resp=resp, cite=cite, rec=rec_t, addl=addl_t))
print("cases", len(rows), "blank-case pages skipped", blank, file=sys.stderr)
import json
json.dump(rows, open(os.environ["TMPDIR"]+"/q/rows.json","w"))
EOF

import re, glob, os, json
UTIL=['centerpoint','northern indiana public service','nipsco','citizens gas','citizens energy','vectren','indiana american water','ohio valley gas','american electric power','duke energy','community natural gas','midwest natural gas','frontier communications']
d="/tmp/r2run-lqu4au25/data/text"
out=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob(d+"/*.txt")):
    txt=open(f,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read()
    parts=re.split(r"^=== page (\d+)\s*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    for i in range(1,len(parts),2):
        pno,body=parts[i],parts[i+1]
        m=re.search(r"Case Number:[ \t]*(\S+)",body)
        if not m: continue
        cn=m.group(1)
        # respondent: text after 'Respondent:' up to 'Other Party' line; fallback to lines
        rm=re.search(r"Respondent:[ \t]*(.*)",body)
        resp=rm.group(1).strip() if rm else ""
        rec=re.search(r"recommends the following[^:]*:(.*?)(Abstentions:|APPROVED|Additional Information:|$)",body,re.S)
        rec_t=" ".join(rec.group(1).split()) if rec else ""
        out.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f),page=pno,case=cn,resp=resp,rec=rec_t,has_rec=bool(rec)))
print("rows",len(out),"no rec",sum(1 for o in out if not o['has_rec']))
def isutil(n):
    n=n.lstrip(' ').lower()
    return any(n.startswith(u) for u in UTIL)
U=[o for o in out if isutil(o['resp'])]; N=[o for o in out if not isutil(o['resp'])]
wl=lambda o: re.search(r'warning letter',o['rec'],re.I) is not None
print("U",len(U),sum(map(wl,U)),round(100*sum(map(wl,U))/len(U),1))
print("N",len(N),sum(map(wl,N)),round(100*sum(map(wl,N))/len(N),1))
print("blank-resp", [ (o['file'],o['case']) for o in out if not o['resp']])
print("uncounted-pages-with-warning-in-rec-but-no-match", [ (o['file'],o['case']) for o in out if 'warn' in o['rec'].lower() and not wl(o)][:10])
EOF
